description: Evaluator approves/rejects (POST /api/intents/[id]/review). Requires { decision, reason, actionNonce, signature } from buildReviewAction(). revision/deliverableHash come from the DATABASE — the evaluator signs what acm_get_intent_status shows. DRY-RUN BY DEFAULT: returns the exact body that WOULD be sent. The caller signs the lifecycle action with the SDK's signing helpers; this tool never signs.

dryRun.description: Default true: show, do not send.

name: acm_review
